question: Which lens will be suitable for a myopic person?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Concave lens**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A concave lens is suitable for a** myopic (nearsighted) person.**
 
• Myopia occurs when the eye is longer than normal or when the **cornea has too much curvature**, causing light rays to focus in front of the retina.
 
• A **concave lens** (also known as a diverging lens) is **thinner in the center and thicker at the edges**.
 
• It **diverges light rays**, which helps move the focal point back onto the retina, allowing distant objects to be seen more clearly.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
